channel.title: Shelby County Newspapers - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Shelby County Newspapers (shelbycountyreporter.com)

item.title: Indian Springs chases redemption after title game heartbreak behind experienced backline
item.description: After coming so close to another state championship, Indian Springs is back for more, relying on its culture and defensive experience to contend in Class 5A once again.

item.title: Pelham softball looks to turn experience into results in 2026
item.description: After a challenging 2025 season, Pelham softball enters the new year focused on growth, accountability and translating experience into wins.

item.title: Chelsea looks to make push into Class 6A state playoffs in year four under Gooch
item.description: The Chelsea Hornets are preparing to take the field for the 2026 soccer season with their eyes set on making it back to the postseason.

item.title: Libby Liberty brings civic lessons to life for Pelham second graders
item.description: Cheers echoed through Pelham Ridge and Pelham Oaks Elementary schools on Wednesday, Jan. 28 as second graders counted down to the arrival of Libby Liberty, a lively Statue of Liberty character who kicked off the Hands on Liberty program for Pelham City Schools.

item.title: Shelby County announces 2026 football schedule in Class 4A, Region 3
item.description: Shelby County dropped its 2026 football schedule, including four home games and non-region matchups with Marbury, Holtville and Oak Grove as they aim for another playoff trip out of Class 4A, Region 3. (File)

item.title: Republican District Judge candidates address voters at forum
item.description: The four candidates running for the newly created Shelby County District Judge, Place 3 position shared their views at a forum that was held at the Shelby County Services Building in Pelham on Thursday, Jan. 29.

item.title: Vincent reveals 2026 football schedule after regional shakeup
item.description: Vincent announced its 2026 football schedule with a completely new Class 2A, Region 6 alongside non-region foes Winterboro, B.B. Comer and Tarrant.

item.title: Pelham girls place second at 6A indoor track state championship, Westminster OM boys finish third
item.description: Pelham earned a red map as the girls Class 6A runner-up in the indoor track and field state championship while Spain Park’s Jonathan Fonbah and the Panthers’ Emily Wester won titles and Westminster OM’s boys finished third.

item.title: Rolling a double: Thompson wins second-straight girls bowling state championship
item.description: Thompson repeated as Class 6A/7A girls bowling state champions after dominating all four of its matchups and beating Hoover twice to win the title.

item.title: Thompson’s 1976 boys basketball team reunites to celebrate 50th anniversary of school’s first state championship
item.description: Thompson High School reunited its 1976 boys basketball state championship team to recognize them for the 50th anniversary of the school’s historic first state title during the Warriors’ win over Huffman.
